# GrabHandRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Validation/Rules/GripRules.cs#L619)

Checks that the hands in the scene can actually hold what they grab.

The grab layer and the physics layer are separate components on separate objects, and a scene
can have one without the other. Nothing throws when it does: the grab fires, finds no physics
hand to hand the object to, and logs at runtime - which is a headset session to discover.
